nodes.description: Partial glucocorticoid deficiency. Basal cortisol is frequently normal, so the deficiency is detected by ACTH stimulation testing and becomes clinically manifest under intercurrent illness, surgery or other stress. Unrecognised, it is the principal preventable cause of death in this disorder, which is why stress-dose cover is the central management point.

evidence.reference_title: Genotype-phenotype analysis in congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: Short cosyntropin testing revealed adrenal insufficiency in 89%.

nodes.description: Choanal stenosis or atresia and midface retrusion can obstruct the neonatal airway. Endotracheal intubation, nasal stents, tracheotomy and tracheostomy are used as needed, which makes airway assessment part of the immediate care of an affected newborn.

nodes.description: 17-hydroxyprogesterone accumulating proximal to the enzymatic blocks enters an alternative "backdoor" androgen pathway that reaches dihydrotestosterone without passing through DHEA or testosterone. Reisch et al. demonstrated that this pathway is active in explants of human fetal adrenal, gonad and genital skin during the sexual-differentiation window, and that androgen receptor is present in genital skin of both sexes. Because the intermediates are 5-alpha-reduced on entry they cannot be aromatized. The pathway ceases shortly after birth, which is why virilization does not progress postnatally.
nodes.id: Alternative Pathway Androgen Synthesis in the 46,XX Fetus

evidence.reference_title: Alternative pathway androgen biosynthesis and human fetal female virilization.
evidence.snippet: Here we employ explant cultures of human fetal organs (adrenals, gonads, genital skin) from the major period of sexual differentiation and show that alternative pathway androgen biosynthesis is active in the fetus, as assessed by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry.

evidence.reference_title: Reply to Flück et al.: Alternative androgen pathway biosynthesis drives fetal female virilization in P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: Alternative pathway steroids are 5α-reduced upon pathway entry and therefore cannot be aromatized.

nodes.description: A disorder of sex development occurs in both karyotypes and in opposite directions: 46,XX individuals are virilized with clitoral hypertrophy and labial fusion, while 46,XY individuals are undervirilized with hypospadias, micropenis and cryptorchidism. Virilization in 46,XX individuals does not progress after birth.

evidence.reference_title: Genotype-phenotype analysis in congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: DSD was present in 15 of 18 46,XX and seven of 12 46,XY individuals.

nodes.description: Biallelic hypomorphic or loss-of-function POR variants reduce the amount, stability or flavin binding of NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase. Reported mechanisms at the protein level include impaired FMN and FAD binding and reduced protein stability; a complete knockout is embryonically lethal in mice, so surviving human disease is caused by partial rather than total loss.

evidence.reference_title: Mutant P450 oxidoreductase causes disordered steroidogenesis with and without Antley-Bixler syndrome.
evidence.snippet: We identified mutations in POR, encoding P450 oxidoreductase, the obligate electron donor for these enzymes, in a woman with amenorrhea and three children with ABS, even though knock-out of POR is embryonically lethal in mice.

genetic_context.description: Germline biallelic POR variants, typically hypomorphic rather than null.

nodes.description: Premature fusion of the cranial sutures, most often coronal and lambdoid, producing turricephaly and accompanied by midface retrusion with proptosis and choanal stenosis or atresia. This is the lead feature of the Antley-Bixler phenotype.

evidence.reference_title: Cytochrome P450 Oxidoreductase Deficiency.
evidence.snippet: Skeletal malformations can manifest as craniosynostosis, mid-face retrusion with proptosis and choanal stenosis or atresia

nodes.description: Alleles that inhibit CYP17A1 preferentially over CYP21A2 shunt steroid flux into the mineralocorticoid pathway, so deoxycorticosterone accumulates and activates the mineralocorticoid receptor, causing sodium retention and volume expansion with suppressed renin. This mirrors isolated 17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency, but it is milder because the inhibition here is partial rather than complete.

Glucocorticoid replacement for cortisol deficiency, with stress-dose cover during intercurrent illness. Because basal cortisol is often normal while the stress response is not, the stress-dose component is the part that prevents adrenal crisis.

evidence.reference_title: Cytochrome P450 Oxidoreductase Deficiency.
evidence.snippet: Glucocorticoid replacement therapy for cortisol deficiency including stress-dose cover in intercurrent illness

nodes.description: The proposed mechanism of the ovarian macrocysts is a double hit: impaired ovarian steroidogenesis removes negative feedback and raises gonadotropins, while reduced CYP51A1 activity lowers follicular-fluid meiosis-activating sterol, a CYP51A1 product needed for oocyte maturation. Follicles enlarge without ovulating.

Bony fusion at the elbow, the limb counterpart of the cranial fusion, with neonatal fractures, congenital bowing of the long bones, joint contractures, arachnodactyly and clubfeet reported alongside it.

evidence.snippet: radiohumeral synostosis, neonatal fractures, congenital bowing of the long bones, joint contractures, arachnodactyly, and clubfeet

nodes.description: Mineralocorticoid excess hypertension, attributed to deoxycorticosterone accumulation when CYP17A1 is inhibited preferentially over CYP21A2. It typically presents in young adulthood rather than childhood, which makes it a reason for continued blood-pressure monitoring into adult life.

evidence.reference_title: Cytochrome P450 Oxidoreductase Deficiency.
evidence.snippet: Mild mineralocorticoid excess can be present and causes arterial hypertension, usually presenting in young adulthood.

nodes.description: Reduced CYP17A1 17,20-lyase activity in the fetal testis lowers androstenedione, testosterone and consequently dihydrotestosterone by the classic route, so the 46,XY fetus is undervirilized during the masculinization window. This branch runs in the opposite direction to the 46,XX branch, and which one dominates is set by the allele - which is how a single disorder undervirilizes one karyotype while virilizing the other.

evidence.reference_title: Genotype-phenotype analysis in congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: DSD was present in 15 of 18 46,XX and seven of 12 46,XY individuals.

nodes.description: Imperforate anus occurred in about 11% of a systematic Japanese series, with no significant difference in frequency between the milder and more severe mutation groups. The authors attribute it, and the urinary anomalies, to aberrant retinoic acid metabolism from CYP26 deficiency rather than to the steroid defect - which is why this entry wires it to the retinoic acid node rather than to the steroidogenic branches.

evidence.reference_title: Anorectal and urinary anomalies and aberrant retinoic acid metabolism in cytochrome P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: Imperforate anus was observed in four patients (10.8%) and vesicoureteral reflux was found in three patients (8.1%), with no significant difference in the frequencies of such anomalies between groups A and B.

evidence.reference_title: Anorectal and urinary anomalies and aberrant retinoic acid metabolism in cytochrome P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: The results imply that aberrant atRA metabolism due to CYP26 deficiency underlies various anorectal and urinary anomalies in patients with PORD.

nodes.description: Reduced CYP26 activity impairs the localized degradation of all-trans retinoic acid, and plasma retinoic acid is raised in most PORD patients tested. Local retinoic acid excess is an established cause of craniosynostosis and skeletal fusions through CYP26B1, and is also the proposed explanation for the anorectal and urinary anomalies reported in PORD. The link from POR to this mechanism is inferred from POR being the electron donor for CYP26 plus the raised patient levels; the direct genetic evidence comes from CYP26B1 rather than from POR.

evidence.reference_title: Craniosynostosis and multiple skeletal anomalies in humans and zebrafish result from a defect in the localized degradation of retinoic acid.
evidence.snippet: We have identified human null and hypomorphic mutations in the gene encoding the RA-degrading enzyme CYP26B1 that lead to skeletal and craniofacial anomalies, including fusions of long bones, calvarial bone hypoplasia, and craniosynostosis.

nodes.description: Midface retrusion with proptosis, and choanal stenosis or atresia, accompany the craniosynostosis. The choanal component is the one with immediate consequences: it is why airway management is part of neonatal care here.

evidence.snippet: Deficient activities of multiple steroidogenic enzymes have been reported without and with Antley-Bixler syndrome (ABS), but mutations of corresponding cytochrome P450 enzymes have not been found.

nodes.description: Impaired flux along the classic cortisol pathway produces partial cortisol deficiency, loss of negative feedback, raised ACTH and adrenal hyperplasia - which is why the disorder is classified among the congenital adrenal hyperplasias. Because the block is partial, basal cortisol is frequently normal and the deficiency is revealed only by ACTH stimulation testing or by physiological stress. That gap between a normal basal value and an inadequate stress response is the clinically dangerous feature.
nodes.id: Partial Cortisol Deficiency with Compensatory ACTH Drive

nodes.description: Reduced CYP51A1 lanosterol 14-alpha-demethylase activity lowers de novo cholesterol synthesis in chondrocytes. Cholesterol is required for hedgehog ligand modification and signalling, so Indian hedgehog signalling falls, chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation are impaired and apoptosis rises - effects rescued in vitro by cholesterol supplementation and by recombinant Indian hedgehog. Disordered endochondral ossification and suture biology follow.
nodes.id: Reduced Chondrocyte Sterol Synthesis and Hedgehog Signalling

evidence.reference_title: P450 oxidoreductase expressed in rat chondrocytes modulates chondrogenesis via cholesterol- and Indian Hedgehog-dependent mechanisms.
evidence.snippet: POR siRNA-transfected chondrocytes exhibited reduced Ihh expression, with such effect being neutralized by cholesterol.

evidence.reference_title: P450 oxidoreductase expressed in rat chondrocytes modulates chondrogenesis via cholesterol- and Indian Hedgehog-dependent mechanisms.
evidence.snippet: Lastly, recombinant human/mouse Ihh prevented the POR siRNA-mediated effects on chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation, and apoptosis.

evidence.reference_title: Mutant P450 oxidoreductase causes disordered steroidogenesis with and without Antley-Bixler syndrome.
evidence.snippet: Mutations of POR also affect drug-metabolizing P450 enzymes, explaining the association of ABS with maternal fluconazole ingestion.

nodes.description: Testosterone replacement in males whose levels remain low after puberty begins, dihydrotestosterone for micropenis in some males, and oestrogen replacement in females with absent pubertal development. Oestradiol is also used to reduce the size of ovarian cysts, which both treats them and supports the gonadotropin-driven account of how they form.

evidence.reference_title: Cytochrome P450 Oxidoreductase Deficiency.
evidence.snippet: treatment with estradiol to reduce the size of ovarian cysts

nodes.description: Reduced electron transfer from NADPH through FAD and FMN to the partner P450 heme impairs every microsomal cytochrome P450 at once - the steroidogenic enzymes CYP17A1, CYP21A2 and CYP19A1, the sterol-synthesis enzyme CYP51A1, the retinoic-acid-catabolising CYP26 family, and the drug-metabolising P450s. The degree of loss is partner-specific for each allele rather than uniform, which is why one variant can cripple CYP17A1 while sparing CYP19A1. That allele-dependent differential is what makes the chain branch, and it is why PORD presents as several apparently unrelated diseases at once.
nodes.id: Simultaneous Partial Loss of Multiple Microsomal P450 Activities

evidence.reference_title: Reply to Flück et al.: Alternative androgen pathway biosynthesis drives fetal female virilization in P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: The electron donor enzyme P450 oxidoreductase (POR) supports the activities of CYP21A2 21-hydroxylase (yellow), CYP17A1 17α-hydroxylase (white), CYP17A1 17,20-lyase (blue), and CYP19A1 aromatase (pink) in a mutation-dependent, differential manner.

evidence.reference_title: Anorectal and urinary anomalies and aberrant retinoic acid metabolism in cytochrome P450 oxidoreductase deficiency.
evidence.snippet: Cytochrome P450 oxidoreductase (POR) is an electron donor for all microsomal P450 enzymes including CYP26 involved in inactivation of all-trans retinoic acid (atRA).

nodes.description: Surgery as needed for craniosynostosis, for hypospadias and cryptorchidism in males, and for clitoromegaly and vaginal hypoplasia in females. Dihydrotestosterone has been used successfully for micropenis in some males.
